description:
Elecz provides real-time electricity prices and cheapest-hour recommendations across 40+ countries, plus electricity contract comparisons in supported markets.

Get live spot prices, find the cheapest hours to run appliances or charge an EV, optimize flexible workloads to reduce electricity costs, and compare electricity contract options where available.

defaultPrompt: What does electricity cost right now?
What are the cheapest electricity hours today?
Which electricity contract is cheapest for me?
